hints.eligibleSet: The eligible set is the union of both collections: filling in either one is enough. A buy-N-pay-M deal adds up the units of every product in the set, so a 3-for-2 can combine two different flavours.
hints.validFrom: In force from 00:00 of that day.
hints.validUntil: Leave it empty to run until you discontinue it.
hints.discontinued: Discontinuing switches the promotion off without deleting it and without touching its dates: it stops applying today and comes back on by unticking this. To take it out of the list, archive it.
hints.overlap: Two promotions may reach the same product: that is allowed and the engine sorts it out. Buy-N-pay-M deals first, then percentages as a cascade, then fixed amounts, and finally the discounts on the total.
